max_budget_usd.description: Maximum amount in US dollars that Claude may spend during one invocation.

max_buffer_size.description: Size limit the Claude Agent SDK applies to one JSON message from Claude Code. Omit to use the SDK default.

reasoning_effort.description: Claude reasoning effort. Omit to preserve the harness default.

approval_mode.description: Codex approval handling mode for escalated permission requests.

config_overrides.description: Dotted Codex configuration keys mapped to JSON-compatible values.

output_schema.description: JSON Schema that constrains the final assistant message for each turn.

reasoning_effort.description: Codex reasoning effort for each turn.

service_tier.description: Codex service tier for the thread.

interfaces.description: Native interfaces served by the runtime as child processes.

api.description: Hermes's API server, run by a gateway child. After every enabled interface starts, the adapter writes its bearer token to interfaces/api.token in the Hermes home: <artifact root>/.fabric/hermes/runtimes/<runtime-id>, or the agent's state folder with runtime.keep_state.

enabled.description: Serve Hermes's OpenAI-compatible API server. A present api interface is on unless this is false.

port.description: Exact loopback port for the API server. Start fails if it is in use.

dashboard.description: Hermes's dashboard, which has no sign-in when bound to loopback. It needs a built frontend at HERMES_WEB_DIST.

enabled.description: Serve Hermes's dashboard and browser chat. A present dashboard is on unless this is false.

port.description: Exact loopback port for the dashboard. Start fails if it is in use.

max_tokens.description: Maximum number of tokens in each Hermes model response.

enabled.description: Whether Hermes model reasoning is enabled.

save_trajectories.description: Whether Hermes saves its native conversation trajectories as JSONL.

startup_timeout_seconds.description: Time for every enabled interface to pass its health check, within NeMo Fabric's 90-second start limit.

terminal_timeout.description: Maximum number of seconds for a Hermes terminal operation.

description.description: Description the main agent uses to select this asynchronous subagent.

graph_id.description: Graph or assistant identifier on the Agent Protocol server.

headers.description: Additional string-valued HTTP headers sent to the Agent Protocol server.

name.description: Unique asynchronous subagent identifier exposed to the main agent.

url.description: Optional Agent Protocol server URL; omit it to use the SDK's default endpoint.

description.description: Description the main agent uses to select this subagent.

interrupt_on.description: Subagent-specific tool interrupt policy; the main agent policy is inherited when omitted.

model.description: Optional provider:model override; the main agent model is inherited when omitted.

name.description: Unique subagent identifier exposed to the main agent.

response_format.description: JSON Schema for this subagent's structured response.

skills.description: Skill source paths loaded only for this subagent.

allowed_decisions.description: Human decisions allowed for this tool call.

args_schema.description: JSON Schema for editable tool arguments.

description.description: Static description shown with the approval request.

deepagents.description: JSON-serializable adapter and Deep Agents options.

backend.description: Optional backend selection. Local shell execution runs directly on the adapter host without process isolation.

interrupt_on.description: Mapping of Deep Agents tool names to human-in-the-loop interrupt policies; omitted tools run without an interrupt.

subagents.description: Caller-defined declarative or asynchronous subagents; the built-in general-purpose subagent remains available by default.

reasoning_effort.description: Reasoning effort passed to ChatOpenAI. Requires an OpenAI-compatible provider; omit to preserve the model default.

approval_mode.description: How Deep Agents Code approves gated actions during invocations, which no person can answer: auto uses its classifier, with the default model, and denies what it escalates; yolo allows every gated action.

insecure_http_model_hosts.description: Explicitly trusted HTTP model endpoint hostnames, without schemes, ports, paths, or wildcards.

interfaces.description: Native interfaces offered by the runtime.

terminal.description: Deep Agents Code's terminal UI, opened by <artifact root>/.fabric/deepagents-code/runtimes/<runtime-id>/interfaces/terminal in a separate session that shares the runtime's configuration and session store.

enabled.description: Write a launcher for Deep Agents Code's terminal UI. A present terminal is on unless this is false.

cost_tracking.description: Use strict SDK pricing, or explicitly disable monetary budgeting for unpriced models. Disabled requires a positive runtime.max_turns; cost remains unavailable.

timeout.description: Maximum duration of one shell command.

supports_usage_in_streaming.description: Whether the configured custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint supports stream_options.include_usage. Requires base_url; omitted values retain OpenClaw capability detection.

agent_id.description: OpenClaw agent selected for NeMo Fabric-originated invocations.

channel_config.description: OpenClaw-native channels and bindings for NeMo Fabric-owned services. Every binding must target the configured agent. Managed runtimes reject channel configuration.

connect_timeout_seconds.description: Timeout for connecting to the local OpenClaw Gateway.

interfaces.description: Native interfaces served by a managed runtime. Services reject interfaces.

dashboard.description: OpenClaw's Control UI. After the Gateway starts, the adapter writes its sign-in token to <artifact root>/.fabric/openclaw/runtimes/<runtime-id>/interfaces/dashboard.token.

enabled.description: Serve the Control UI. A present dashboard is on unless this is false.

port.description: Exact loopback Gateway base port, which serves the Control UI. Start fails if it or port + 2 is in use, and OpenClaw reserves ports through port + 110. Can't be combined with port_range.

openclaw_command.description: OpenClaw executable name or path. Relative paths containing a directory are resolved from the NeMo Fabric base directory.

port_range.description: Inclusive consumer-allocated port range. The adapter selects a Gateway base port whose complete derived footprint through base + 110 fits within the range. When omitted, the adapter selects an available local range.

read_timeout_seconds.description: Timeout between response bytes from the local OpenClaw Gateway. When unset, the invocation timeout bounds the response.

shutdown_timeout_seconds.description: Maximum graceful Gateway shutdown time before forced termination.

startup_timeout_seconds.description: One deadline for all of start, from checking the OpenClaw command to the Gateway becoming ready, within NeMo Fabric's 90-second start limit.

scope_reasons.description: Bounded reasons invocation ownership or completion could not be proved; contains no native messages, commands, or credentials.

insecure_http_model_hosts.description: Explicitly trusted HTTP model endpoint hostnames, without schemes, ports, paths, or wildcards.

model.description: Pi-specific catalog metadata for a model Pi does not already ship natively. `api` is the model's wire protocol and must be supplied for an unknown (gateway-served) model; when omitted Pi inherits a built-in model's native api.

api.description: The wire protocol Pi uses to talk to this model.

cost.description: Per-million-token pricing. All four rates are required and non-negative.

insecure_http_model_hosts.description: Hosts trusted for credential-free HTTP model forwarding through NeMo Relay >=0.11.0; no schemes, ports, paths, wildcards, brackets, or zone identifiers.

relay_extension_path.description: Absolute path or environment.workspace-relative path to the NeMo Relay Pi extension matching the CLI release

base_url.description: Remote agent API root, including the /v1 path segment.

connect_timeout_seconds.description: Timeout in seconds for connecting to the remote agent.

read_timeout_seconds.description: Timeout in seconds between response bytes from the remote agent.

relay_streaming.description: Whether the remote service accepts NeMo Fabric request correlation metadata and publishes ATOF to the configured Relay stream sink.
